findings.summary: In self-employed mode there's no calculation for 1–5 years. The 4-year bar is empty, so the only number shown is the comparison figure (25,725), which is easy to mistake for the fund's number.
Tapping '8' on the year numbers under the chart set the picker to 7, so the input you get isn't the one you chose.
The 'נשאר בידיים' value at 8 years appears only above its column, not in the list below, and the white column is hard to see next to the others.
The 'הכנסה חייבת בחודש' field in self-employed mode is unclear: it doesn't say whether it needs changing or what it affects.
